newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products steady, except dipping gas oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady, except dipping gas oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady on Friday morning, except gas oil which lost around $2 due to futures weakness, dealers said.
The whole of the Rhine remained navigable, but barges were still unable to move into tributaries in Germany. Frozen Dutch canals also hampered traffic.
Gasoline was unchanged from late on Thursday when a eurograde barge traded at $224.75 fob Rotterdam. Dealers said demand was yet to emerge on Friday.
Gas oil was down $2 a tonne, with premiums unchanged.
Prompt offers remained at IPE Jan +$2.50 fob ARA. Dealers said demand was muted, as barges were unable to access a number of potential customers.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were steady and bunker demand thin. Barges were still offered at $118 fob ARA.
